data.narrative:
Synhelion is a Series C climate and energy company founded by Gianluca Ambrosetti that has raised $80M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy (KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Helion, Redwood Materials among them) and 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $80M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $136M. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector, same-stage comparables: KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M. The median valuation across this peer set is $1.0B, with a range of $700M–$3.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $116M–$1.1B, with a median of $568M. The wide spread reflects material dispersion in peer valuations within Climate & Energy Series C financings. Stage-progression yields the conservative anchor at $136M; peer-median suggests substantially higher multiples, though comp heterogeneity—driven by technology risk, capital intensity, and commercialization timeline differences—creates significant uncertainty. Resolution of Synhelion's technology maturity and path to revenue relative to named peers would be required to narrow the range materially.
